> 4 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Api under Payment Tokens. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Payment Tokens

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/payment-tokens/v3/payment-tokens-create): Creates a Payment Token from the given payment source and adds it to the Vault of the associated customer.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/payment-tokens/v3/setup-tokens-create): Creates a Setup Token from the given payment source and adds it to the Vault of the associated customer.

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/payment-tokens/v3/payment-tokens-delete/): Delete the payment token associated with the payment token id.
